PRINCETON, N.J., Sept. 03, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- ANI Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: ANIP) (ANI or the Company) today announced that Nikhil Lalwani, President and Chief Executive Officer, along with members of the Company’s executive leadership team, will participate in fireside chats at the following upcoming investor conferences:


Event 2026 Wells Fargo Healthcare Conference


Date Thursday, September 10, 2026


Time 1:30 p.m. ET


Webcast[Click here](https://event.summitcast.com/view/aMepMFxWv3z5SRZ9meKJzp/NEveQ9CKXVDHvcjeRqeN5G)


Event Morgan Stanley 24th Annual Global Healthcare Conference


Date Monday, September 14, 2026


Time 7:00 a.m. ET


Webcast[Click here](https://event.webcasts.com/starthere.jsp?ei=1773862&tp_key=03c01fdb98&tp_special=8)


Event H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investment Conference

Time 12.00 p.m. ET


Webcast[Click here](https://journey.ct.events/view/409e490a-1440-40e9-9423-37209ce6f109)

**About ANI**


ANI Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: ANIP) is a diversified biopharmaceutical company committed to its mission of “Serving Patients, Improving Lives" by developing, manufacturing, and commercializing innovative and high-quality therapeutics. The Company is focused on delivering sustainable growth through its Rare Disease business, which markets novel products in the areas of ophthalmology, rheumatology, nephrology, neurology, and pulmonology; its Generics business, which leverages R&D expertise, operational excellence, and U.S.-based manufacturing; and its Brands business. For more information, visit[https://www.anipharmaceuticals.com.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=yfnLoUni600sBVnY_bZiudAAtu7nlNlkXu_RhOL4LpxyD-FjiS9InP6cd-Iktp9zvJzhIyJZ0_r18_y2ScJOoDHSK2dLcgxJA6C1EixCZvFdrsIjN7APNP56eYhoq8nPUpjW_AMtHt0LphcIqufRGA==)
